fullContentHtml:
ISRO URSC Various Post Online Form 2026 – Full Details

Indian Space Research Organisation (ISRO) has released the notification for the post of Technician-B, Heavy Vehicle Driver-A, Light Vehicle Driver-A, Staff Card Driver-A. This recruitment has been issued for 61 posts. Online applying process for ISRO URSC Various Post Recruitment 2026 has started from 24 October 2026 & the candidates can apply till 13 November 2026. Candidates must check the complete details for ISRO URSC Various Post Recruitment 2026 which has given below.

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 24 October 2026
  • Last Date : 13 November 2026
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 13 November 2026
  • Exam Date : Notify Later
  • Admit Card : Before Exam

Application Fee

  • General, OBC, EWS : Rs. 500/-
  • SC, ST, PH, ESM : Rs. 500/-
  • All Female Category : Rs. 500/-
  • Refund of Fees After Appear Exam
  • General, OBC, EWS : Rs. 400/-
  • SC, ST, PH, ESM, Female : Rs. 500/-

How to Apply Online

  1. Click on the direct Apply Online link in the Important Links section below.
  2. Complete new registration with your Name, Email, and Mobile Number.
  3. Fill the application form with personal, educational, and address details.
  4. Upload scanned photograph, signature, and required certificates.
  5. Pay the applicable examination fee online and download the submission receipt.
